description: Every cryptographic use in this app. docs/crypto.md is generated from this file; keep both in step.
principles: Only algorithms built into Node.js (node:crypto) are used; there are no third-party cryptography packages.
Keys and secrets come from the environment (.env) and are never written into code or logs.
Random values come from the operating system's cryptographically secure generator (crypto.randomBytes / randomUUID).
MD5 and SHA-1 are never used for security purposes (HMAC-SHA1 appears only inside the TOTP standard, RFC 6238).

entries.algorithm: argon2id (memory 64 MiB, 3 passes, parallelism 4) when Node.js provides crypto.argon2; otherwise scrypt (N=2^17, r=8, p=1, 64-byte key)
entries.keyOrSalt: 16 random bytes of salt per password
entries.storage: PHC string in users.password_hash; both formats are verified
entries.rotation: Not needed; a change of algorithm is applied on the next successful sign-in when the stored format differs

entries.algorithm: 32 random bytes (base64url) in the cookie; HMAC-SHA256 with SESSION_SECRET stored in the database

entries.purpose: Protecting sensitive columns at rest (one-time code seeds and fields marked sensitive)
entries.algorithm: AES-256-GCM with a 96-bit random nonce and a 128-bit authentication tag; table, column and row id are bound as additional authenticated data
entries.keyOrSalt: FIELD_KEYS (numbered 32-byte keys); ACTIVE_FIELD_KEY chooses the key for new data
entries.rotation: Add a new key id, point ACTIVE_FIELD_KEY at it and run npm run rotate-field-key

entries.purpose: Password reset links and invitation links
entries.algorithm: 16 random bytes (base64url) sent to the user; HMAC-SHA256 with TOKEN_HMAC_KEY stored
entries.storage: password_resets.token_hash; 15 minutes (reset) or 7 days (invite); single use

entries.purpose: Machine access to the JSON API (optional feature)
entries.algorithm: 32 random bytes (base64url) with an 8-character prefix; HMAC-SHA256 with TOKEN_HMAC_KEY stored
entries.rotation: Keys are revoked and re-issued through the app

entries.algorithm: HMAC-SHA1 over a 30-second counter, 6 digits, one step of tolerance, replay of an accepted step refused
entries.keyOrSalt: 20 random bytes per user, stored with field encryption
entries.rotation: Users can switch codes off and set them up again

entries.purpose: Backup sign-in when the phone is lost
entries.algorithm: 10 codes of 10 base32 characters (50 bits each) from random bytes; HMAC-SHA256 with TOKEN_HMAC_KEY stored
entries.rotation: A new set is issued when one-time codes are set up again

entries.purpose: Proving that a form or API call came from this site
entries.algorithm: 32 random bytes (base64url) kept in the server-side session and compared in constant time

entries.purpose: Allowing only the app's own scripts and styles to run
Making the security event log tamper-evident
entries.algorithm: SHA-256 over the previous row's hash plus the canonical JSON of the row

entries.purpose: Referring to sessions and email addresses in logs without revealing them
entries.algorithm: First 8 or 12 hex characters of SHA-256
TLS 1.2 or newer with AES-GCM and ChaCha20-Poly1305 cipher suites only
entries.keyOrSalt: certs/key.pem and certs/cert.pem from npm run gen-cert (or a certificate you supply)
entries.rotation: Re-run gen-cert or replace the files; restart the app
